prompt: At latitude 30 degrees north, find the geometric upper-transit altitude of declination −20 degrees, in degrees.
explanation: Upper-transit altitude is 90° − |φ − δ|. With φ = 30° and δ = −20°, |30 − (−20)| = 50°, so the altitude is 90 − 50 = 40°.

prompt: Local sidereal time is 10 hours and right ascension is 7 hours. Find the westward hour angle in degrees, using H=LST−RA.
hint: Convert the three-hour angular difference at 15 degrees per hour.
explanation: H = LST − RA = 10 h − 7 h = 3 h. Each hour of hour angle is 15°, so H = 3 × 15 = 45°.
